propositions: rebar transition has two distinct force flags (--force for start-work gate, --force-close for close gate) while rebar claim uses --force consistently, causing agent confusion and documentation errors
the --force-close flag must be renamed to --force with dispatching logic keyed on target status, and retired invocations must raise CommandError rather than silently skip
bare --force on a close transition records (no reason given) as the reason and bypasses completion-verification gate, matching claim behavior
existing --force --reason=X invocations on open->in_progress must preserve X as the audit note under the new --force=<reason> kwarg contract
stale call sites emitting --force-close must fail loudly (CommandError naming --force), not be silently discarded by the hand-rolled flag loop
tree-wide grep and call-site parser tests must guard against concurrent changes re-introducing the retired flag spelling after merge
